result.title: Tight Mistake-Abstention Tradeoffs for Sequential Prediction under Adversarial Injections
result.summary: We study the sequential prediction problem introduced by Goel et al. (2023), where an adversary can inject arbitrarily many corrupted instances in an i.i.d. stream from a clean distribution $μ$, while the learner is allowed to abstain from making a prediction at no cost if the current instance was indeed injected. When $μ$ is unknown, Yu and Blanchard (2026) show a polynomial tradeoff between mistakes and false abstentions for classes with finite VC dimension and oblivious adversaries, but still leave open a significant gap between upper and lower bounds in their tradeoff landscape. In this paper, we propose the weighted shattering potential, and based on variants of this potential, provide gap-closing algorithms that essentially characterize the tradeoffs under various settings of interest: When $μ$ is known, our algorithm improves over Goel et al. (2023) and achieves their conjectured $O(d\log T)$ mistake bound; When $μ$ is unknown, for oblivious adversary, our guarantees are tight both in $T$ and in terms of the VC dimension $d$, which completely characterizes the abstention-mistake tradeoff in this setting and gives an $O(\sqrt{dT})$ balanced rate. For adaptive adversary, our results are tight up to $\operatorname{poly}(dD\log T)$ factors for structured classes with finite so-called reduction dimension $D$. Our guarantees also extend to censored feedback, where the label is hidden after an abstention.

AI.brief_summary: 研究对抗者可注入任意多污染样本的 i.i.d. 序贯预测问题，提出加权 shattering potential 及相应算法，在 μ 已知、μ 未知（oblivious 与 adaptive 对手）及删失反馈下给出误差与弃权代价的紧致权衡界。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「错误—弃权」权衡刻画可为 LVR 中 STOP 决策的收益与成本、停止规则设计提供形式化参照，但设定是带注入噪声的序贯预测、不涉及视觉证据获取与 latent 状态，可迁移性待核查。
